albumYearCorrections.basis: The archive page itself states 'এটি কোন অ্যালবাম নয়' ('this is not an album') — a curated selection, not one dated release. 6 of its 13 songs match Saregama's 1996 release 'Amar Ei Path Chaoatei Ananda' (JioSaavn tracklist cross-check); a 7th matches the 1997 'Sanchayan' compilation that repackages it. 1996 is the best available date for the bulk of the collection, not a confirmed date for the whole.
